title: 第23章一夜四层
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
陈青山没立刻去碰金红晶砂。

    刚补出来的两本残册还摊在床板上，墨味、纸灰味、湿炭味混在一起，屋里呛得人嗓子发痒。他先把《小离火锻器诀·上篇》和《三十六基础灵纹补注》重新包好，外面仍套着那几张破封皮。

    破就破。

    越破越安全。

    他把两本书塞到床板夹层，又把《控火入门残篇》的旧绳重新捆上，放在桌角最显眼的位置。

    万一有人进来，第一眼看见的只会是一堆烂纸。

    随后，他开始布置屋子。

    门缝本来塞着布，他又往下压了一层炉灰。窗缝也没放过，旧布条塞进去以后，再用半干的泥抹了一道。床边那块丑铜胚被他故意摆歪，边上摊开复炼记录，墨迹涂得乱七八糟。

    炉子里添了两块湿炭。

    烟一冒，整间屋子立刻呛得人睁不开眼。

    陈青山自己都咳了两声。

    好味儿。

    柳青霜若真半夜来查，先闻到的也是炉烟，不是灵气。

    他又从小瓷瓶里倒出一粒回气丹，没吃，捏碎了一点点，抹在袖口和桌边。药味混进烟里，淡得不明显，却能给“熬夜炼坏了，只能吃丹回气”这个说法留条路。

    做完这些，他才打开石柜夹层。

    夹层里用破布包着三粒金红晶砂。

    米粒大小，颜色却压得住眼。拿在指间，热意顺着皮肉往里钻，不烫，却很躁。

    这东西是夹金丝矿石被造化鼎炼出来的，火性重，元气也足。先前他一直没敢乱用，一来怕撑坏经脉，二来没有合适的运转法门。

    现在有了。

    小离火锻器诀。

    上篇。

    虽然残得很有规矩，但好歹是能用的规矩。

    陈青山用刻刀在一粒晶砂上刮下半粒大小的碎粉，剩下的重新包好塞回夹层。碎粉落在掌心，红得发暗，贴着皮肉发躁。

    他看了半晌，还是没急。

    先坐下，调息。

    灵力沿旧路转了一圈，丹田里那团气旋仍旧不大，火性灵力散在边上，碰一下就乱蹿。以前他催火，靠的是硬压。压得住就成火，压不住就炸炉。

    说难听点，全靠蛮力。

    他按《小离火锻器诀》第一段，把那股散火往少阳、阳池两处经脉里引。第一遍走得慢，慢到胸口发闷。第二遍稍顺一点，火力不再乱撞，而是顺着经脉缝隙往前钻。

    第三遍时，陈青山把掌心那点金红碎粉送入口中。

    没有丹药的甜腻，也没有铁元晶那种硬邦邦的金气。

    入口先是涩。

    然后热。

    热流从喉咙一路滚下去，落进腹中时，丹田里猛地蹿起一撮火星。

    陈青山牙关一紧，差点骂出声。

    “操！”

    这半粒也太冲了。

    他赶紧按新法压火。

    旧法是堵。哪里乱，就拿灵力往哪里堵。堵来堵去，经脉发胀，人也累得半死。

    新法不一样。

    它不堵。

    它绕。

    那股金红热流被引着过少阳，入阳池，再分三息，慢慢落回丹田。原本要炸开的火气被拆成细股，一点点喂进气旋里。

    一周天。

    丹田里的气旋亮了一圈。
content_en:
Chen Qingshan did not touch the golden red crystal sand immediately.

    The two broken books that had just been repaired were still spread out on the bed board. The smell of ink, paper ashes, and wet charcoal mixed together, making the room choke and make people's throats feel itchy. He first rewrapped "Xiao Li Fire Forging Technique Part 1" and "Thirty-six Basic Spirit Pattern Supplementary Notes", with the broken covers still on the outside.

    If it breaks, it breaks.

    The more broken it is, the safer it is.

    He stuffed the two books into the bed board, retied the old rope of "An Introduction to Fire Control" and placed it in the most conspicuous place on the corner of the table.

    If someone comes in, the first thing they see will be a pile of junk paper.

    Then he began to decorate the house.

    The crack in the door was stuffed with cloth, so he pressed down a layer of ashes. The cracks in the window were also left untouched. After stuffing the old cloth strips in, they wiped it with half-dried mud. The ugly copper embryo beside the bed was deliberately tilted by him, and the refining records were spread out beside it, with ink stains all over it.

    Two pieces of wet coal were added to the stove.

    As soon as the smoke came out, the whole room was choked and people couldn't open their eyes.

    Chen Qingshan even coughed twice.

    Delicious.

    If Liu Qingshuang came to check in the middle of the night, the first thing she would smell was furnace smoke, not spiritual energy.

    He poured another Qi-Reviving Pill from the small porcelain bottle. Without eating it, he crushed a little bit and spread it on his sleeves and the edge of the table. The smell of medicine is mixed into the smoke, so light that it is not obvious, but it can leave a way for the saying that "if you stay up late and practice, you can only take elixirs to regain your energy."

    After doing this, he opened the mezzanine of the stone cabinet.

    There are three grains of gold-red crystal sand wrapped in rags in the interlayer.

    The size of a grain of rice, but the color is eye-catching. Holding it between your fingers, the heat penetrates into the skin and flesh, not hot, but very irritating.

    This thing is made from gold-threaded ore and refined by the cauldron of creation. It has strong fire properties and sufficient vitality. He had never dared to use it indiscriminately before. Firstly, he was afraid of damaging the meridians, and secondly, he did not have a suitable method to operate it.

    Now there is.

    Xiaoli Fire Forging Technique.

    Previous article.

    Although the disability is very disciplined, it is still a functional discipline.

    Chen Qingshan used a carving knife to scrape off half a grain of powder from a grain of crystal sand, and rewrapped the rest and stuffed it back into the sandwich. The powder fell on the palm, turning dark red and sticking to the skin.

    He looked at it for a long time, but was still in no hurry.

    Sit down first and adjust your breathing.

    The spiritual power circled along the old road, but the cyclone in the Dantian was still not big. The fire-type spiritual power was scattered on the edge, and it would jump out when touched. In the past, he relied on hard pressure to stimulate the fire. If it can be suppressed, it will become a fire; if it cannot be suppressed, it will explode.

    To put it harshly, it all depends on brute force.

    He followed the first paragraph of "Xiao Li Fire Forging Technique" and directed the scattered fire to the two meridians of Shaoyang and Yangchi. The first time I walked slowly, my chest felt tight. The second time it was a little smoother, the firepower no longer hit randomly, but drilled forward along the gaps in the meridians.

    On the third time, Chen Qingshan put the golden red powder in his palm into his mouth.

    It doesn't have the sweetness of elixirs, nor does it have the hard golden energy of Tie Yuan Jing.

    The entrance is astringent at first.

    Then heat.

    As the heat rolled down his throat and fell into his abdomen, a handful of sparks suddenly shot up in his Dantian.

    Chen Qingshan clenched his teeth and almost cursed.

    "Fuck!"

    This half pill is too strong.

    He quickly followed the new method to suppress the fire.

    The old method is blocking. Wherever there is chaos, use spiritual power to block it. There are blockages, the meridians are swollen, and the person is almost dead from exhaustion.

    The new law is different.

    It doesn't block.

    It goes around.

    The golden-red hot current was led past Shaoyang, into Yangchi, and then divided into three breaths before slowly falling back to Dantian. The fire energy that was about to explode was split into thin strands and fed into the cyclone bit by bit.

    days a week.

    The cyclone in Dantian lit up.
